{{Quote|Looks like our old friends are back. They seem to have recovered from that scare we gave them at Linuri.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Dark Force" />}}
The '''Raid on Linuri''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]].

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Linuri]] was home to an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] base commanded by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis's]] forces attacked the planet but were defeated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] and retreated.
